description: This file defines the ICatalogItemService interface which declares methods for creating, editing, deleting, and retrieving catalog items, likely used for catalog management in an eCommerce application.

classes.name: ICatalogItemService
classes.description: An interface that declares asynchronous methods for managing catalog items such as creating, editing, deleting, and listing.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item asynchronously.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Edits an existing catalog item asynchronously.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item by its ID asynchronously and returns a status message.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a catalog item by its ID asynchronously.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Lists catalog items with pagination, returning a subset based on page size.
